title: HandoffReady — current local delivery review, 17 October 2026
disclosure: Actual app captures · edited walkthrough · agent-operated synthetic demo

captures.caption: Check outgoing files against the brief before sending them to a client. This packet and operator actions are synthetic.
Three promises: logo formats, three distinct launch images, and a guide to updating the website contact email.
Gemma proposes the checklist. Review every source quote, required format and quantity before confirming.
The duplicate filter finds two files with identical bytes. Different filenames do not make distinct artwork.
The selected PNG fails the narrow transparency check. Recording an assessment cannot erase that finding.
Gemma linked a welcome-only guide. The operator inspects its text and records Needs work: the promised instructions are missing.
Save a snapshot of this delivery. Shared requirement titles and client notes still need a confidentiality review.
Replacing a file makes all three earlier reviews stale. Recheck the evidence before confirming a new delivery.
After fresh review, two items still need attention and one technical check still fails. The new draft retains those gaps.
The exported record retains outstanding work. Send the original files alongside it; this is not a claim of client acceptance.
